newsitem.title: USA: Tommy Hilfiger to launch products globally.
newsitem.headline: Tommy Hilfiger to launch products globally.

text.p: Tommy Hilfiger Corp said Tuesday it would in the next few months market new licensed products as part of its efforts to become a global brand.

"Looking forward, our efforts over the next several months will further our plans to become a global brand," said Chief Executive Joel Horowitz. "Our licensee will begin marketing our men's sportswear collection throughout Europe and "Tommy Girl," our licensed women's fragrance, will launch in many Asian and European countries. In addition, we will see the openings of our specialty retail store on London's highly visible Sloane Street and our first flagship store on Rodeo Drive in Beverly Hills. At the same time our infant and toddler line will make its retail debut."

For the first quarter ended June 30, 1997, net revenue grew to $173.7 million from $124.1 million for the first quarter of last year. Net income increased to $17.5 million from $12.6 million in the same period a year ago. Earnings per share were $0.46, up from $0.34 in the comparable quarter last year.

"In a generally tough retail environment, our results reflect the strength of the Tommy Hilfiger brand as well as the diversity of our revenue and earnings base. We recorded healthy revenue increases in our boys, licensing and retail segments and continued growth in our men's wholesale business," Horowitz said.

During the quarter the company signed a licensing agreement with Revman Industries to produce and market a line of bedding, linens, bath products and accessories. The line marks the Company's entry into the home furnishings market.
Tommy Hilfiger Corp through its subsidiaries designs, sources and markets men's sportswear and boyswear under the Tommy Hilfiger trademark.
Through a range of strategic licensing agreements, the company is expanding its product lines to offer a broader array of apparel, accessories, footwear and fragrance for men, women and children.
